"""Read the catalog file and look books up."""

FIELDS = ("isbn", "title", "author", "year", "price_cents")


def load_catalog(path):
    """Every book in the tab-separated file at path, as a dict with FIELDS as keys."""
    books = []
    with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as handle:
        for line in handle:
            line = line.rstrip("\n")
            if not line or line.startswith("#"):
                continue
            book = dict(zip(FIELDS, line.split("\t"), strict=True))
            book["year"] = int(book["year"])
            book["price_cents"] = int(book["price_cents"])
            books.append(book)
    return books


def find(books, title=None, author=None):
    """The books whose title and author contain the given text, ignoring case."""
    found = []
    for book in books:
        if title and title.lower() not in book["title"].lower():
            continue
        if author and author.lower() not in book["author"].lower():
            continue
        found.append(book)
    return found

"""The shelf command: python3 -m shelf list data/catalog.tsv"""

import argparse
import sys

from .catalog import load_catalog
from .money import format_price


def cmd_list(args):
    books = load_catalog(args.catalog)
    width = max(len(book["title"]) for book in books)
    for book in books:
        price = format_price(book["price_cents"])
        print(f"{book['title']:<{width}}  {book['author']} ({book['year']})  {price}")
    return 0


def build_parser():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="shelf")
    commands = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
    listing = commands.add_parser("list", help="list every book in a catalog")
    listing.add_argument("catalog")
    listing.set_defaults(handler=cmd_list)
    return parser


def main(argv=None):
    args = build_parser().parse_args(argv)
    return args.handler(args)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

def format_price(cents, currency="EUR"):
    """12345 -> '123.45 EUR'."""
    return f"{cents / 100} {currency}"

"""The shelf command: python3 -m shelf list data/catalog.tsv"""

import argparse
import sys

from .catalog import load_catalog, search
from .money import format_price


def print_books(books):
    if not books:
        return
    width = max(len(book["title"]) for book in books)
    for book in books:
        price = format_price(book["price_cents"])
        print(f"{book['title']:<{width}}  {book['author']} ({book['year']})  {price}")


def cmd_list(args):
    books = load_catalog(args.catalog)
    if args.title:
        books = search(books, args.title, fields=("title",))
    print_books(books)
    return 0


def cmd_search(args):
    print_books(search(load_catalog(args.catalog), " ".join(args.words), year=args.year))
    return 0


def build_parser():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="shelf")
    commands = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
    listing = commands.add_parser("list", help="list every book in a catalog")
    listing.add_argument("catalog")
    listing.add_argument("--title", help="only books whose title contains every one of these words")
    listing.set_defaults(handler=cmd_list)
    searching = commands.add_parser("search", help="find books by words in the title or author")
    searching.add_argument("catalog")
    searching.add_argument("words", nargs="+")
    searching.add_argument("--year", type=int, help="only books published in this year")
    searching.set_defaults(handler=cmd_search)
    return parser


def main(argv=None):
    args = build_parser().parse_args(argv)
    return args.handler(args)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
